admission.justification: The captured shared-region proof detects duplicate card/row rendering and loss of an individual entry identity, both of which would misstate what was reviewed.

applicability: Changed card-read entries rendered by the review page change-set model, within one comparison.
conditions: An entry identity names entry id, after side when recorded else before side, named path, resolved mapped range when available and all four comparison trees.
A code-without-invariant hunk identity names its path, mapped before/after spans and the two code trees.
A shared region requires the same entry kind and both sides to name the same path/range or absent-file region; unresolved/unreadable sides do not merge.
The first location draws the shared entries; others retain identity keys as aliases and draw no duplicate row/card. Counts remain by entry, not drawn card.
A subject with multiple family occurrences draws its blocks at the first occurrence only.
exclusions: Coalescing merely equal paths with distinct mapped regions.
Replacing per-entry identities or authored rationales with the identity of the first entry.
Claiming every family occurrence is a separate drawn block.
Recorded-source-expression grouping by path and recorded source identity, owned by INV-XX178P3W; that route is not the review page's mapped-region drawing.
